Card Q&A.a: You can attack with it. But when you do, even if the memory counter moves to 1 or higher on your opponent's side, you don't switch turns until the attack is finished.
Card Q&A.q: Can I attack with this Digimon if I don't have 2 or more memory?

Effect: ＜Blocker＞ (When an opponent's Digimon attacks, you may suspend this Digimon to force the opponent to attack it instead.)
